raw_segments.text: He could not utter a word.
This was not at all, not at all the way he had intended to tell, and he did not understand
what was happening to him now.
She went up to him softly, sat down on the bed beside him and waited, not taking her
He turned his deadly pale face to her.
His lips worked, helplessly struggling to utter something.
A pang of terror passed through Sonya's heart.
